app_type: hybrid_fullstack (document processing dashboard / SaaS app for electricity & power plant industry)

theme.description: High-clarity industrial utility dashboard tailored for power plant engineers, PLN inspectors, and administrative staff preparing LHPP documents for SIUjang Gatrik compliance.

primary_brand.description: Electric Sky Blue - representing power transmission, technology, and official verification.

accent_energy.description: High-Voltage Amber - for highlight actions, confidence warning badges, and active drag-drop zones.

typography.font_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous interior padding (p-6 to p-8) with clear structural borders to prevent data overcrowding.

key_panels.description: Branding SIUjang Gatrik Assistant, Template Switcher dropdown, dark/light mode toggle, and live SIUjang Ready checklist progress summary pill.
Drag and drop zone with pulse border animation, sample LHPP generator button ('Coba File Contoh LHPP PLTD'), file detail badge, and [Analisa PDF] button with step-by-step progress tracker.
Extracted metadata card grid (Nomor Laporan, Tanggal, Perusahaan, Instalasi, Kapasitas, Inspector) + Interactive SIUjang Readiness checklist with auto-validation status.

Dense data table & responsive grid showing detected documents, content-aware page bounds (Halaman Awal - Akhir), confidence meter badge (e.g. 98%, 68%), required checkbox toggle ('Diperlukan'), inline page & title edit modal trigger, and row quick action bar.
Sticky bottom or prominent action panel with count of selected files, [SPLIT DOKUMEN TERPILIH] button, and [DOWNLOAD ZIP SEMUA] option.
Split workspace with visual page thumbnail filmstrip on the left and full embedded PDF viewer / page inspector on the right.
Configuration drawer to manage document classification templates (LHPP PLTD, PLTU, PLTG, PLTS, Substation/Gardu) with key keywords and item structures.

key_features_mapping.PDF Drag & Drop Upload Area: Dropzone with active border highlight, file type validator (.pdf), file size calculation, and quick reset.
key_features_mapping.Analisa PDF Button with Progress Steps: Simulated or real OCR/Structure analysis engine showing progressive step badges: 1. Membaca PDF -> 2. Mendeteksi Struktur -> 3. Identifikasi Judul & Tabel -> 4. Batas Halaman -> 5. Selesai.
key_features_mapping.Detection Results Table: Columns: Checkbox (Select), No, Nama Dokumen (edit inline), Halaman (e.g., Hal 1-4), Confidence Score Badge (High/Warn/Low), Status Badge (✓ Siap / ⚠ Perlu Review), Actions (Edit, Preview, Download).
key_features_mapping.Inline Edit & Manual Override: Allows user to adjust document title, start page, end page, add missing document split, or delete false positive splits.
key_features_mapping.Document Selection Checkboxes: Filters and highlights 'HANYA DOKUMEN YANG DIPERLUKAN' with batch select all / deselect optional documents.
key_features_mapping.Split Selected Documents Button: Triggers splitting algorithm for selected documents only, generating distinct named PDF files.
key_features_mapping.PDF Preview: Browser embed + Thumbnail grid with highlight overlay showing start page and end page boundary.
key_features_mapping.Download Options: Download single document file or batch Download ZIP containing structured folder of split PDFs.
key_features_mapping.Document Template Manager: Preset rules for LHPP PLTD, PLTU, PLTS, and General Electrical Inspection Reports.
key_features_mapping.Extracted Metadata Panel: Extracted key parameters formatted cleanly with copy-to-clipboard buttons for SIUjang portal copy-pasting.
key_features_mapping.SIUjang Ready Status Checklist: Automated checklist verifying all required documents (e.g. Sertifikat Kelaikan Operasi, Hasil Uji Peralatan, Drawing Single Line, Laporan Pemeriksaan) are present and verified.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text, labels, messages, buttons, and notifications use natural, accurate Bahasa Indonesia suitable for Indonesian power plant inspectors and PLN engineers.
Provide sample PDF test files / instant sample data generator button so users can test document analysis instantly without needing their own PDF file.

Implement full end-to-end client/server flow: upload multi-page PDF, auto-detect boundary pages using title & keyword regex rules, present confidence scores, allow manual page range editing, select required files, and generate downloadable single/ZIP files.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, input, checkbox, table row, and tab for automated test compatibility.
Use Lucide icons or Radix UI icons for clean technical presentation (e.g. FileText, Scissors, Download, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle, Eye, RefreshCw, Settings).
Ensure confidence score badges clearly differentiate High Confidence (90-100%, Green), Medium Confidence / Perlu Review (60-89%, Amber), and Low Confidence (0-59%, Red).
Make the SIUjang Ready checklist interactive so users can mark manual verifications or see auto-validated checks update in real time.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_transparent_headers: DO NOT use transparent background in sticky header or overlays. Always use solid or glassmorphism background with explicit text colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.hover_contrast: Always explicitly define hover text colors matching background contrast.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.micro_interactions: Include subtle hover animations, loading spinners, and toast notifications via Sonner for all user actions.
